players.bio: Beck-Ray Enoru (born 25 August 2002) is a Cameroonian professional footballer who currently plays as a forward or winger for EFL League One club Notts County.
Callum Roberts (born 14 April 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League One club Notts County.

Conor Michael Grant (born 23 July 2001) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Notts County. Conor Grant joined Sheffield Wednesday from Shamrock Rovers on the 26 May 2017, joining the U-18 side. He would then sign his first professional contract on 11 December 2018.

Daniel Malanga Kanu is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Notts County on loan from EFL Championship side Charlton Athletic. Born in England, he plays for the Sierra Leone national team.
Darius Lipsiuc is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Notts County.

Dean Graeme Campbell (born 19 March 2001) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Notts County . Dean Campbell was coached from the age of 4 at former Leicester and Everton FC midfielder Ian Wilson's coaching schools in Aberdeen.
Emile Acquah is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for Notts County.

Harry Griffiths (Footballer, born 2005) is a 20-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Notts County. He joined the club from Nottingham Forest's academy in 2023 and has also spent time at AFC Wimbledon.

Hindolo Thomas Eric Mustapha (born 29 July 2006) is a footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or forward for EFL League One club Notts County, on loan from Crystal Palace. Born in England, he represents Sierra Leone internationally.

Ishé Barrington Samuels-Smith (born 5 June 2006) is an English footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for League One club Notts County, on loan from Premier League club Chelsea. Club career Born in Manchester, Samuels-Smith joined the academy of Everton at the age of nine.

Jack Evans (Born 2000): A defensive midfielder and left-back who joined Notts County in July 2026 from Harrogate Town. After coming through Blackburn Rovers' academy, he played for Forest Green Rovers, FC Halifax Town, and Harrogate Town, where he won both the Players' and Fans' Player of the Season awards for 2025–26.

Jacob Mitchell Bedeau (born 24 December 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Notts County. On 31 January 2017, Bedeau joined Championship club Aston Villa on a two-and-a-half-year deal for a fee around the margin of £900,000.

James Michael Belshaw (born 12 October 1990) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Notts County. In 2009, Belshaw rejected a one-year professional contract with Walsall, and instead moved to the United States to play college soccer at Duke University. He made 78 appearances for the Blue Devils between 2009 and 2012.
James Andrew Gibbons is an English professional footballer who plays as a full-back for EFL League One club Notts County.
Lindokuhle "Lee" Ndlovu (born 8 December 1994) is a Zimbabwean professional football player who plays as a striker for EFL League One club Notts County.
Lewis Jon Macari (born 8 February 2002) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Notts County.
Lucas Benjamin Ness (born 7 February 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for Notts County.
Luke Browne is a 21-year-old Irish professional football player who plays as a centre-back for Torquay United on a short term loan from Notts County.

Martin Andrew Paterson (born 10 May 1987) is a professional football manager and former player who is the head coach of EFL League Two club Notts County. Born in Stoke-on-Trent, he began his career with Stoke City, making his senior debut in April 2005.
Matthew Thomas Palmer (born 27 February 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Notts County.
Matthew Baker (born 6 February 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Notts County.
Matthew James Platt (born 3 October 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Notts County.
Max Harrison Sanders is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Notts County.
Qamaruddin Maziar Kouhyar (born 30 September 1997) is an Afghan professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Notts County. He is the first Afghan to play professionally in Great Britain.
Nicholas Andrew Tsaroulla (born 29 March 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a wing back for EFL League One club Notts County. Born in England, he plays for the Cyprus national team.
Oliver Joseph Cooper is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Notts County on loan from EFL Championship club Swansea City, and the Wales national team.
Rodney Troy McDonald (born 11 April 1992) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Notts County.

About Rory James Finneran is a footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL League One club Notts County, on loan from Premier League club Newcastle United. Born in England, he is a senior Republic of Ireland international, having made his debut in May 2026.

Rosaire Longelo-Mbule (born 20 October 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left back for EFL League One club Notts County. Career After playing for West Ham United and Newcastle United, Longelo signed with Accrington Stanley in January 2022. Personal life Longelo was born in Kinshasa in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, before moving to England as a child.
Scott Alexander Cameron Robertson (born 27 July 2001) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL League One club Notts County.
